_generator.name: Hand-authored ARM template — single source of truth. No Bicep, no auto-compile, no drift.

metadata.comments: XdrLogRaider v0.1.0 GA — pure Defender connector. Requires an existing Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace. Provisions 13 per-category DCRs sharing 1 DCE for 65 stream declarations (64 manifest streams [63 live + 1 deprecated] + 1 XdrConnectorHealth_CL ops). Routes to 11 consolidated workspace tables (10 Defender_<Category>_CL + 1 XdrConnectorHealth_CL). Adds GenericUI Data Connector card with 385 sample queries + 8 workbooks + 20 analytic rules + 12 hunting queries + 4 drift parsers. Operators bring their own KQL.

metadata.description: Project prefix used in resource names. 3-12 lowercase alphanumeric.

Resource ID of an existing Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace.
Azure region of the existing workspace.
UPN of the read-only service account the connector authenticates as.
Restrict public network access on Storage, Key Vault, and Application Insights.
Send Key Vault audit logs to the workspace. Default OFF for v0.1.0 GA App-Insights-only architecture; operators with KV-audit compliance requirements set true.
GitHub repo (owner/name) hosting the Function App release.

Operators bring their own KQL parsers, rules, and workbooks. v0.1.0 GA. Source: https://github.com/akefallonitis/xdrlograider
properties.descriptionHtml:
Microsoft Sentinel custom data connector — 64 Defender XDR portal-only telemetry streams (configuration, compliance, drift, exposure, governance, identity) consolidated into 11 Log Analytics tables (10 Defender_<Category>_CL + 1 XdrConnectorHealth_CL). PowerShell 7.4 Function App + 13 DCRs sharing 1 DCE + Key Vault for SA credentials. Operators bring their own KQL.

v0.1.0 GA. Source: github.com/akefallonitis/xdrlograider
properties.author: [variables('solutionAuthor')]

connectorUiConfig.title: XdrLogRaider — Defender XDR portal telemetry
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
Polls Microsoft Defender XDR portal-only endpoints. Authentication: unattended TOTP or software passkey via the service account.

**See the XdrLogRaider solution in the Content Hub for the full set of workbooks, analytic rules, hunting queries, and sample queries.** Streams + tables landed are listed below under **Data types**.

Reference: [github.com/akefallonitis/xdrlograider](https://github.com/akefallonitis/xdrlograider)

graphQueries.baseQuery: union Defender_ActionCenter_CL, Defender_ConfigurationAndSettings_CL, Defender_EndpointConfiguration_CL, Defender_EndpointDeviceManagement_CL, Defender_ExposureManagement_CL, Defender_IdentityProtection_CL, Defender_MultiTenantOperations_CL, Defender_StreamingApi_CL, Defender_ThreatAnalytics_CL, Defender_VulnerabilityManagement_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize Rows=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
XdrConnectorHealth_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where Tier != 'Heartbeat' | summarize StreamsSucceeded=max(StreamsSucceeded) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Tier
XdrConnectorHealth_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where Tier == 'Heartbeat' | summarize Heartbeats=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

sampleQueries.query: XdrConnectorHealth_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where Tier != 'Heartbeat' | summarize StreamsSucceeded=max(StreamsSucceeded), RowsIngested=sum(RowsIngested) by Tier

sampleQueries.description: Per-stream success classification (live | live-empty | tenant-gated | error)
sampleQueries.query: XdrConnectorHealth_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where Tier != 'Heartbeat' | extend Reason = column_ifexists('Reason', '') | summarize Streams=dcount(SourceName) by Reason | order by Streams desc

sampleQueries.description: ASR rules + AV + EDR + Firewall policies per platform (Intune/MEM, portal-only)
sampleQueries.query: Defender_EndpointConfiguration_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_SecurityPolicies_CL' | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EntityId | project TimeGenerated, EntityId, Platform, RawJson

Defender_ConfigurationAndSettings_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_TenantAllowBlock_CL' | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EntityId | project TimeGenerated, IndicatorType, AllowBlockAction, CreatedBy, CreatedTime

sampleQueries.description: XSPM exposure recommendations — latest top 10 by impact
sampleQueries.query: Defender_ExposureManagement_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_ExposureRecommendations_CL' | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EntityId | top 10 by TimeGenerated desc | project TimeGenerated, EntityId, RawJson
MDE_Drift_Configuration(6h, 1h) | summarize Events=count() by ChangeType, StreamName | order by Events desc
customEvents | where name in ('AuthChain.AADSTSError', 'AuthChain.Completed') | order by timestamp desc | take 10

instructionSteps.title: Upload auth secrets to Key Vault
instructionSteps.description: Either provide them via the deploy wizard (Authentication step → Upload via wizard) **or** run the helper script after deploy:

instructionSteps.title: Confirm connector liveness
instructionSteps.description: Within 5-10 minutes the Function App's heartbeat timer + first poll fire. The connector card reads XdrConnectorHealth_CL for the IsConnected indicator. For auth chain diagnostics, query App Insights customEvents:
